about: Which of the records' pre-vote hooks run on a committee's own day, ahead of the floor, instead of on the floor day. A hook named here fires once for a bill, at the committee stage; a hook not named fires on the floor day as before. Owner ruling Oct 19, 2026: the committee's day runs whatever the records already fire for a body on a sitting day, at the stage the body's own rules put them, from data, with nothing invented for the committee.
ownVote: The player's own vote is not cast on a committee's day: it is settled at the vote itself, where the player is stopped (owner's card, Nov 14, 2026, 02:03Z: "Stop me at every vote").
source: Staff briefings, interest groups organizing and public comment all happen before a committee reports in the state and local bodies that have committees (NCSL, 'Legislative Committee Structures', 2024; the hearing is where the public comments and the members are lobbied). The game runs each once per bill, at the committee, where the body has one.
